title: Rammeavtale for brøyting og strøing på Byglandsfjord
description: Bakgrunn Bygland kommune har behov for å etablere en ny rammeavtale for brøyting og strøing på Byglandsfjord og i tilstøtende grender, da eksisterende avtale utløper. Formålet er å sikre nødvendig framkommelighet og trafikksikkerhet på kommunale veger og i grendeområdene gjennom vinterhalvåret. Anskaffelsen skal dekke kommunens behov for beredskap og rask utrykning ved snøfall og glatte forhold. Utrykning utløses av kommunal vakt, og leverandøren må kunne støtte kommunen i å opprettholde stabile vinterdriftstjenester i aktuelle områder. Beskrivelse av oppdraget Oppdraget gjelder vinterdrift i form av brøyting og strøing på Byglandsfjord og i tilstøtende grender. Leveransen omfatter brøyting av kommunale veger og relevante grendeveger, samt strøing ved behov når føreforholdene tilsier dette. Leverandøren skal tilby døgnkontinuerlig beredskap i vintersesongen og kunne rykke ut etter varsling fra kommunal vakt. Oppdraget forutsetter egnet og driftssikkert utstyr med tilstrekkelig kapasitet til å utføre arbeidet tilfredsstillende i de aktuelle områdene, herunder på smale grendeveger og på steder der det kan være behov for annet utstyr enn ordinær ploging. Det legges til grunn at arbeidet skal utføres med god kvalitet og med enkel oppfølging og rapportering per oppdrag. Kommunen vil gi nødvendig opplæring før oppstart. Rammeavtalen har en varighet på 4 år, med opsjon på forlengelse 1 + 1 år. Øvre ramme for avtalen er 1 500 000 kroner ekskl. mva., og avtalen opphører når kostnadstaket er nådd.

title: Rammeavtale for vintervedlikehold i avgrenset havneområde
description: Bakgrunn Bergen Havn har behov for å etablere en ny rammeavtale for vintervedlikehold i et avgrenset havneområde. Vinterberedskap er nødvendig for å ivareta trygg fremkommelighet og sikker drift i havneområdet gjennom vintersesongen. Området omfatter trafikk- og driftskritiske arealer der vær- og føreforhold kan endre seg raskt, og hvor det er behov for at tiltak kan iverksettes på kort varsel. Anskaffelsen skal legge til rette for tydelig samhandling, effektiv håndtering av hendelser knyttet til snø og is, samt løpende koordinering mellom partene. Beskrivelse av oppdraget Oppdraget omfatter levering av vintervedlikeholdstjenester i et avgrenset område under Bergen Havns ansvarsområde. Tjenesten skal understøtte sikker og hensiktsmessig fremkommelighet i vintersesongen og vil bli styrt gjennom en sone-/rodeinndeling med tilhørende nivå for utførelse, jf. bilag 1a. Det er forventet at leverandør skal kunne rydde i flere områder samtidig ved behov under store nedbørsforhold. Leveransen omfatter i hovedsak brøyting, snømåking og tiltak mot glatt føre, herunder salting og/eller strøing. Ved behov skal leverandøren også kunne håndtere bortkjøring av snø når lokale lagringsmuligheter er utilstrekkelige. Oppdraget inkluderer vinterberedskap med vaktordning og mulighet for utrykning ved hendelser, slik at nødvendige tiltak kan gjennomføres ved varierende vær- og føreforhold. Rammeavtalen skal understøtte effektiv samhandling mellom partene, herunder varsling, løpende koordinering, enkel dokumentasjon og rapportering knyttet til utførte oppdrag som grunnlag for oppfølging og kontroll. Bergen Havn ønsker en proaktiv leverandør.

Bestandteil des Leistungsumfangs sind die Digitalisierung der Kondensatableiterpopulation, regelmäßige Expertenanalysen, Optimierungsberichte und Handlungsempfehlungen zur Steigerung von Energieeffizienz, Anlagenverfügbarkeit und Nachhaltigkeit. description: Předmětem plnění veřejné zakázky je realizace stavebních prací spočívajících v odstranění stávajících nefunkčních rybích přechodů na řece Kamenici v lokalitách Divoké soutěsky a Edmundovy (Tiché) soutěsky na území Národního parku České Švýcarsko, včetně odstranění jejich kotvicích prvků, provedení souvisejících přípravných, bouracích a rekultivačních prací a uvedení dotčených ploch do původního stavu. Předmětem plnění je zejména: • zajištění přípravy staveniště v obtížně přístupném terénu soutěsek řeky Kamenice, •vybudování nebo využití zařízení pro bezpečný přesun stavebního materiálu a demoličního odpadu přes tok řeky Kamenice (lanovka, případně další vhodná mechanizace), •vyznačení a zabezpečení prostoru provádění prací, •ruční odstranění konstrukcí stávajících rybích přechodů z důvodu omezeného přístupu, citlivosti lokality a přímého kontaktu stavby s vodním tokem, •odstranění betonových konstrukcí rybích přechodů včetně jejich kotvení do skalního masivu a odstranění kotevních prvků, •odvoz a likvidace vzniklého stavebního odpadu v souladu s platnými právními předpisy, •provedení terénních úprav v místech odstraněných konstrukcí, •zasypání vzniklých prohlubní vhodným materiálem a úprava povrchu dotčených ploch, •obnovení dotčeného území do stavu odpovídajícího charakteru okolního přírodního prostředí. Součástí předmětu plnění je rovněž zajištění všech činností nezbytných pro řádné provedení prací, zejména zpracování technologického postupu provádění prací, dodržení podmínek ochrany přírody vyplývajících z umístění stavby v území Národního parku České Švýcarsko, zajištění bezpečnosti práce a ochrany vodního toku během realizace. Cílem veřejné zakázky je odstranění stávajících nefunkčních rybích přechodů jako prvního kroku ke zlepšení migrační prostupnosti toku řeky Kamenice při zachování přírodních hodnot území a provozních podmínek turistické plavby v soutěskách.

Staldgade 16 stilles vederlagsfrit til rådighed for Fotografisk Center af nuværende forpagter. Fotografisk Center har oplyst, at de er meget interesseret i at fortsætte på adressen. Aftalen mellem Fotografisk Center og nuværende forpagter ophører, når aftalen med DGI-byen udløber ultimo juni 2027.Koncessionshaveren skal i Aftaleperioden minimum afholde det fastlagte antal Kulturdage, Arrangementsdage og Arrangementsdage med kulturindhold, jf. title: Microscale thermophoresis device
description: Microscale thermophoresis device University of Oulu, Biocenter Oulu, seeks a spectral shift and microscale thermophoresis device to characterise qualitatively and determine quantitatively nanoparticle, including protein, interactions in the range of weak to tight binders in solution without immobilization (hereinafter referred to as the "device"). The device must enable the assessment of sample quality and aggregation and differentiating binding events from aggregation. The device will be used for analysis of interactions of fluorescence labelled proteins with small molecules and vesicles. The detection must be independent of the mass ratio of the binding partners. The device must enable fast screening of interactions as well as sensitive affinity measurement. The measurable dynamic range of dissociation constant must be at least in nM -mM range and binding affinity in at least nM -mM range. Low sample consumption (in order of 10 microlitre) and low nanomole of the labeled target is needed for the measurement. The device must enable detection of the interaction based on changes of emission spectrum of exited fluorophore under isothermal conditions and must be able to create a microscopic non-isothermal temperature field (temperature gradient) and determine nanoparticle including protein binding events based on the temperature related intensity change and fluorescence intensity change following thermophoresis under the thermal gradient. Intensity changes and/or spectrum shifts of the fluorescence probe versus ligand concentrations are measured and plotted to calculate the dissociation constant. The device must come with detailed documentation of all features. The device will be part of the Proteomics and protein analysis core facility infrastructure of Biocenter Oulu. The core facility has an open access policy, and the instrumentation and software must be easy to use and maintain. The device must include a user interface to control the operation. The device must be well suited to an academic multi-user environment. description: Department of Veterans Affairs Veterans Health Administration Program Contracting Activity Central (PCAC) August 13, 2026 PRESOLICITATION NOTICE Initial Outfitting, Transition, and Activation Services in support of the Gainesville, FL OPC 100% SDVOSB SET ASIDE This is a Pre-Solicitation Notice that the Veterans Health Administration (VHA) intends to solicit quotes to provide non-personal Initial Outfitting, Transition, and Activation (IOT&A) services for Gainesville, FL Outpatient Clinic (OPC). This requirement supports VHA's mission by providing contractor support services to help bring the hospital into full planned operations that will provide health care services to Veterans. This will be a firm-fixed-price contract with an estimated Period of Performance of 46-months. The North Florida/South Georgia Healthcare System has been approved for a major lease to create an expanded service opportunity for Veteran health care at Gainesville OPC Consolidation. This project proposes to lease a new outpatient clinic in Gainesville, FL. This project is approximately 188,418 net usable square foot (NUSF) in the vicinity of Gainesville, FL, including 1300 parking spaces. The clinic will expand on care currently provided at the existing contracted lease spaces and allow an expansion to the current footprint as well as added new for a decompression of the Malcom Randall VA Medical Center (VAMC) in Gainesville, FL. The lease would allow VA to consolidate outpatient services at one location for mental health, home based primary care, specialty care and ancillary diagnostics identified in the Strategic Capital Investment Planning (SCIP) process. The scope includes project support for planning, activating, outfitting, and transitioning the staff and Veterans/patients associated with the project The scope includes project support for planning, activating, outfitting, and transitioning the staff and Veterans/patients associated with the project. The scope of services includes Comprehensive Project Management, Comprehensive Interior Design, FF&E, and Space Planning Support; CONOPS and Transitioning Planning; Acquisition Support Services to include package development, Activation, Delivery, Relocation and Installation, Training, and Turnover and Post Occupancy Support for the identified project. This requirement will be set-aside 100% for Service-Disabled Veteran-Owned Small Businesses (SDVOSBs) using FAR Part 12 and 37. To be eligible for an SDVOSB set aside under VA s Veterans First Contracting Program, SDVOSBs must: be verified by the Department of Veterans Affairs (VA) as SDVOSB (see https://search.certifications.sba.gov/ for details) and meet the small business size standard for NAICS 541614. The solicitation is anticipated to be posted on Contract Opportunities for download on or about 10 September 2026. Potential offerors are advised that there may be truncated response time on the solicitation that will follow this Pre-Solicitation notice. Anticipated closing date of the solicitation will be 9 October 2026. Solicitation initial posting date and the closing date are subject to change as necessary. Any questions for this Pre-solicitation notice should be sent via e-mail to both Katherine.Johnson@va.gov and Kathleen.Klotzbach@va.gov. No telephone requests/questions will be accepted. This Pre-Solicitation notice does not constitute a request for proposals. P.O.C: Katherine.Johnson@va.gov, Contract Specialist and Kathleen.Klotzbach@va.gov, Contracting Officer

title: Large Area Display System (LADS)
description: Sources Sought Notice Number: H9224126S61892 The Technology Application Program Office (TAPO) is conducting market research to identify potential vendors capable of responding to the requirements described below. This is a Sources Sought Notice issued in accordance with Federal Acquisition Regulation (FAR) Part 10 and does not constitute a Request for Proposal (RFP), nor does it oblige the Government to issue a solicitation or award a contract. The Government does not intend to award a contract based on this request, so quotes will not be considered. No reimbursement will be made for any costs associated with providing information in response to this synopsis or any follow-up information requests. Response is strictly voluntary; it is not mandatory to submit a response to this notice to participate in any formal RFP process that may take place in the future. However, it should be noted that information gathered through this notice may significantly influence the Government�s acquisition strategy. All interested parties will be required to respond separately to any solicitations posted as a result of this sources sought notice. Requirements: The Government seeks to identify potential sources with aircraft Large Area Display System (LADS) for military rotary wing Air Vehicle Systems (AVS) that are commercial products. These airborne avionics grade display system will serve as the primary human machine interface for pilotage and situational awareness tasks by the aircrew. Safety-critical video processing and control are expected to reside externally to the LADS. The Government is interested in a display subsystem capable of deterministic, bounded-latency presentation of video and symbology as an endpoint within an existing Cockpit Display System architecture. The system must be designed with a Modular Open Systems Approach (MOSA) to ensure interoperability, reusability, and future growth. Attributes of interest are Size, Weight, and Power (SWaP), environmental and electromagnetic susceptibility characteristics, and display characteristics. Further details are available to potential sources that the Joint Certification Program (JCP) have certified as eligible for access to unclassified, non-public military technical data and have a current JCP approved DD Form 2345, Military Critical Technical Data Agreement. Key Information: NAICS Code: 334511 (Search, Detection, Navigation, Guidance, Aeronautical, and Nautical System and Instrument Manufacturing). Interested sources may recommend other NAICS Codes for consideration. Small Business Size Standard: The small business size standard is 1,350 employees. PSC: 1680 - Miscellaneous aircraft accessories and components. Response Requested: Interested parties are invited to submit a capabilities statement (on company letterhead) demonstrating their qualifications, capabilities and experience in providing the requirement. Responses should be no longer than 10 pages and include the following: 1. Source Profile: A. Company Name and Address B. Affiliate Information (parent companies, joint ventures, potential teaming partners) C. Year Established & Number of Employees D. Two Points of Contact (Name, Title, Phone, Email) E. Unique Entity ID and CAGE Code (as registered in SAM: http://www.sam.gov/) F. Business Size & Designation (must correlate with SAM registration) 2. Technical Capability Describe the LADS offered relative to the requirement above, to include display size and resolution, luminance range and night vision imaging system compatibility, SWaP characteristics, video and symbology interfaces supported, and qualification and certification status. 3. Commercial Product Status A. Whether the LADS is of a type customarily used by non-governmental entities for other than governmental purposes, and whether it has been sold, leased, or licensed, or offered for sale, lease, or license, to the general public. B. FAA Technical Standard Order authorization, if any (TSO number and revision). C. Rotary wing installations under a Type Certificate or Supplemental Type Certificate, if any (TC/STC number, aircraft make and model, approximate units fielded). 4. Small Business Considerations A. Whether the respondent is the manufacturer of the LADS. If not, ability to comply with the nonmanufacturer rule. B. Ability to comply with the applicable limitation on subcontracting. 5. Administrative Current SPRS Basic Assessment score and date; current CMMC level and assessment type; foreign ownership, control, or influence status. description: L’appalto ha per oggetto l’affidamento del servizio di gestione della struttura per anziani denominata “Centro socio assistenziale San Michele”, che costituisce la parte preponderante del contratto, oltre ai seguenti servizi integrativi: – fornitura del servizio infermieristico alla popolazione residente; – fornitura di bagni protetti agli anziani richiedenti; – fornitura di pasti da erogare a domicilio agli anziani richiedenti; – fornitura di pasti da erogare agli utenti della mensa scolastica comunale; – assistenza agli alunni trasportati sullo scuolabus comunale; – assistenza agli alunni frequentanti la mensa scolastica comunale; – pulizia locali indicati dal Comune, ambulatorio infermieristico; – servizi aggiuntivi a richiesta e discrezione del Comune. Il Centro socio assistenziale “San Michele” è una struttura di proprietà comunale, sita a Entracque in via Ospedale n. 72, nel centro del paese, ubicata in un edificio storico, un tempo utilizzato come Ospedale di carità e Ospizio. La sede è stata oggetto di ristrutturazione edilizia, di riqualificazione e di efficientamento energetico negli anni 2024-2026. La struttura, che permette un’ospitalità permanente, risulta in possesso delle autorizzazioni necessarie al funzionamento finalizzato alla “Progettazione ed erogazione di servizi socio-sanitari ed assistenziali rivolti ad anziani autosufficienti e non autosufficienti in regime di residenzialità”. Le caratteristiche della struttura e della gestione sono specificate nel progetto per l'affidamento della gestione globale del centro socio assistenziale "San Michele" approvato con deliberazione di Giunta del Comune di Entracque n. 52 del 24/06/2026; con deliberazione di Giunta del Comune di Entracque n. 64 del 26/08/2026 è stata invece approvata la versione aggiornata del quadro economico.
